theorem t996 (U : Type) (P Q : U → Prop) (R S : U → U → Prop) (a b c d e : U) (x y z w : U) (h1 : (((Q x) ∨ (R d e)) ∨ ((S y e) ∧ (S c d)))) (h2 : (¬ (¬ (S d c)))) : ((∃ z : U, (((Q x) ∨ (R d z)) ∨ ((S y z) ∧ (S c d)))) ∧ (¬ (¬ (S d c)))) :=
  (show ((∃ z : U, (((Q x) ∨ (R d z)) ∨ ((S y z) ∧ (S c d)))) ∧ (¬ (¬ (S d c)))) from ⟨(show (∃ z : U, (((Q x) ∨ (R d z)) ∨ ((S y z) ∧ (S c d)))) from ⟨e, h1⟩), h2⟩)

theorem t997 (U : Type) (P Q : U → Prop) (R S : U → U → Prop) (a b c d e : U) (x y z w : U) (h1 : ((∀ z : U, (R z x)) → ((Q d) ∨ (S b e)))) (h2 : (Q y)) : (∃ w : U, (((∀ z : U, (R z x)) → ((Q w) ∨ (S b e))) ∧ (Q y))) :=
  (show (∃ w : U, (((∀ z : U, (R z x)) → ((Q w) ∨ (S b e))) ∧ (Q y))) from ⟨d, (show (((∀ z : U, (R z x)) → ((Q d) ∨ (S b e))) ∧ (Q y)) from ⟨h1, h2⟩)⟩)

theorem t998 (U : Type) (P Q : U → Prop) (R S : U → U → Prop) (a b c d e : U) (x y z w : U)  : (False → (S x a)) :=
  (show (False → (S x a)) from ((show (∀ w : U, (False → (S x w))) from (fun (e : U) => (show (False → (S x e)) from (fun (h1 : False) => (show (S x e) from (False.elim h1)))))) a))

theorem t999 (U : Type) (P Q : U → Prop) (R S : U → U → Prop) (a b c d e : U) (x y z w : U) (h1 : ((P a) ∨ (¬ (R a x)))) (h2 : False) : ((((P a) ∨ (¬ (R a x))) ∨ (R d x)) ∧ False) :=
  (show ((((P a) ∨ (¬ (R a x))) ∨ (R d x)) ∧ False) from ⟨(show (((P a) ∨ (¬ (R a x))) ∨ (R d x)) from (Or.inl h1)), h2⟩)
